about: The old (8.x hand) bindings' answers to the 26 SubD component queries of RH-99868, per fixture and SubD, component by component: frozen at the switch-over (M3, 2026-10-31) from the old module in the vNext dev tree, the oracle test_subd_component_queries_rh99868 compared against live before. faces q: HasEdges, HasSharpEdges, SharpEdgeCount, MaximumEdgeSharpness, IsConvex, IsPlanar(1e-8), IsPlanar(1.0), MaterialChannelIndex, TexturePointsAreSet, TexturePointsCapacity; sub: SubdivisionPoint; tc: TextureCenterPoint; tp: TexturePoint(i). vertices q: IsSmooth, IsCrease, IsCorner, IsDart, IsSharp(True), IsSharp(False), VertexSharpness. edges q: IsSmooth, IsCrease, IsHardCrease, IsDartCrease, DartCount; sub; cc: ControlNetCenterPoint; cn: ControlNetCenterNormal(i). A point is [x, y, z], "nan" for an unset coordinate.
